name: flux
description: Package manager for the flux family. Fetches pipes and the declarations that turn them into dot-verbs.
author: takakix2
notes: `verbs` is empty ON PURPOSE, not yet-to-be-written. A dot-verb is for a pipe that carries records through a chain; this is the tool that *installs* those pipes, so it has nothing to put on the wire. It also deliberately does not claim `profile: flux-cli/v1` -- that profile is for producers and transforms, and requires stdout to hold records only, whereas this talks to a person. Install it and type `flux pipe ...`.
